scene.title: Insert 3 into a min‑heap
scene.summary: A new value is placed at the next free spot then swapped upward while it is smaller than its parent.

beats.title: Current min‑heap
beats.narration: The heap satisfies parent ≤ children, so 5 is the minimum at the root.

beats.title: Insert 3
beats.narration: Insert 3 at the next free position, as the left child of 7.

beats.title: First swap up
beats.narration: 3 is smaller than its parent 7, so they swap.

beats.title: Second swap up
beats.narration: Now 3 is smaller than its new parent 5, so they swap, making 3 the new root.
